question: What beneficent role is attributed to the new-moon goddess Amā?
premises: On that day the supreme goddess goes forth
This Amā is identified as that supreme goddess
She is described as making peace and delight
inference: Amā, as the supreme goddess manifest on the new moon, is invoked to bring peace and delight.
uncertainties: The sense of prayāti as movement or manifestation is context-dependent.
plain_english: On which day this supreme goddess comes forth, may this Amā, who brings peace and delight, be so for me.
